The test image shows a soybean leaf with numerous small, dark brown, irregularly-shaped spots scattered across the green upper leaf surface. Some spots have merged into slightly larger blotches. No yellow halos, no gray centers, no pustules.

**Key matching evidence:**
- Small, irregularly shaped, dark brown lesions on the leaf surface — classic Septoria brown spot early/mid stage
- Spots scattered across the leaf without pattern to veins
- Leaf still green (early progression), consistent with Septoria before yellowing/defoliation phase
- No reddish-brown borders with gray centers (ruling out Frogeye), no yellow halo (ruling out Bacterial Blight), no pustules (ruling out Bacterial Pustule or Soybean Rust)

The reference collage confirms the same small dark brown spot pattern.
